title: Google supercharges machine learning tasks with TPU custom chip
author: Norm Jouppi
notes: Fetched live 2026-11-05: TPUs running in Google datacenters for more than a year; an order of magnitude better performance per watt (~7 years / three Moore's-law generations ahead); apps running within 22 days of first tested silicon; used for RankBrain, Street View and AlphaGo.

title: Quantifying the performance of the TPU, our first machine learning chip
author: Norm Jouppi
notes: Fetched live 2026-11-05: need emerged ~six years earlier; three minutes of daily voice search per user on CPUs would have required doubling Google's datacenters; TPUs in production since 2015; 15-30x faster and 30-80x better TOPS/W than contemporary CPUs/GPUs on production inference.
